# xyops_alerts (Data Source)

Searches alert invocations (firing events of alert definitions) with search_alerts. Useful queries include `active:true`, `alert:<alert id>` and `server:<server id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: alert invocations that are still active.
data "xyops_alerts" "active" {
  query = "active:true"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of rows to return. Defaults to 100.
- `offset` (Number) Zero-based row offset for pagination. Defaults to 0.
- `query` (String) Search query in the xyOps index syntax, e.g. `active:true`, `alert:<alert id>`, `server:<server id>`, `start:>=today`. Defaults to all records.

### Read-Only

- `alerts` (List of Object) Matching alert invocation records in the order xyOps returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alerts))
- `total` (Number) Total number of matching records, without pagination.

<a id="nestedatt--alerts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `alerts`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean)
- `alert` (String)
- `count` (Number)
- `date` (Number)
- `exp` (String)
- `groups` (List of String)
- `id` (String)
- `jobs` (List of String)
- `message` (String)

- `notified` (Boolean)
- `server` (String)
- `tickets` (List of String)
